scope: Research reply-local controller consuming FineSpanReader predictions and exact live prefix observations. Never accept teacher trajectories, gold handles, external route overrides or future token sequences. No free-reply accuracy claim.
state_policy: Bind initial route for the reply. normal emits base argmax. supported idle uses predicted START and predicted byte handle; active cursor alone selects subsequent value tokens. First step after value emits base under END and returns idle. A second requested activation beyond configured pilot limit is an explicit error, not silent suppression. EOS closes the controller.
insufficient_policy: Return NEEDS_UNCERTAINTY with no token and no canned text, then refuse token commits. Query-only natural uncertainty generation remains unimplemented and is not replaced with base generation.
integrity: Two-phase propose/commit, exact action identity and emitted-token acknowledgement, no second propose before commit. Bind model/input versions, scope/request/context/snapshot/codec, actual prefix, frozen FP32 C hidden/logits. Invalid or stale action, state change, unsafe value or budget failure enters FAILED with no fallback. Reserve one token/context slot before entering value mode for END handoff.
native_gate: Same12 natural inputs selected by index, no labels/teacher reply read. Fresh 0.5B initial C prefix and ordinary reference for each case; bitwise hidden/logit parity and no cross-request KV reuse. Feed actual untrained predictions into controller. If it requests uncertainty, retain no-token blocked result; do not manufacture a response or change weights to create START.
software_gates: insufficient emits no token and cannot commit
predicted START then uninterrupted cursor then END
repeated activation limit is explicit failure
fixture_policy: Positive/normal/transition branches may use explicitly marked synthetic frames and stubbed predictions in unit tests only, with an explicit opt-in; never combine those counts with native untrained predictions or call them learned memory.
stop: No optimizer, seed search, trained checkpoint, full C/HTTP serving, LoCoMo, sealed test or inherited CG-003 training budget. V2 remains incomplete: uncertainty generation, broader cases and full reply review still required.
